description: Credit card earn rates: the bank points (or miles) a card earns per dollar, euro or pound, by spending category (flights and hotels booked direct or through the bank's travel portal, dining, groceries, rent, everything else), with the card's issuing country, caps and conditions, and the as_of date. Covers Amex Platinum and Gold (US), Amex Business Platinum, Chase Sapphire Reserve and Preferred, Capital One Venture X, Citi Strata Elite, Bilt Palladium, Amex Platinum in Belgium, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany and France, Revolut Ultra, and Miles & More co-brand cards in Germany and Switzerland. Use it for "how many points does my card earn on X", to pick the card to pay with, and to pass points_per_unit_paying_cash to points_value. For cash-back and crypto cards use cashback_cards.

card.description: Card slug or name, e.g. "amex_gold_us", "Sapphire Reserve", "Amex Platinum"; null = every card (filter by country)

category.description: Spending category; null = every rate the card has. A card with no bonus for the category returns its base rate (everything_else).

country.description: Country the card was issued in, ISO code (US, BE, NL, UK, DE, FR, CH); null = any. The same card name earns differently by country (Amex Platinum earns 5x on flights in the US, 1 point per euro in Belgium).

name: earn_rates
title: Card earn rates
